name: Companion Auto Summon
gameplay_verification_scope: Combined 0.8.2 registered production0.4.7 and native menu0.8.0 at23:58:46 on27 September2026 after a43-file verified backup and final save-hash recheck. Two Mods/12 native targets, automation ON,17 unchanged payloads. The DDS was staged and verified; visible icon/summon and six-control behavior are not yet confirmed.
previous_live_result: 0.4.0 applied Random and successfully summoned slot 3 from three eligible owned pets on a planet, confirmed by the user; manual favorite slot 1 stayed in runtime. 0.3.3 verified station summoning and restart restoration, 0.3.2 planetary summoning. These observations do not validate the new 0.4.1 biome preference. In combined play trial 0.6.1, 0.4.2 registered with automation ON and the log recorded an accepted station queue after ship exit at 20:18:19 on 27 September 2026; actual appearance was not separately confirmed.
actual_framework_import_and_gui_properti: Passed with the real pyMHF 0.2.4 and DearPyGui: eight widgets constructed and preference callbacks exercised with temporary files, no viewport, hook registration, native game calls or game launch
launcher_validation: 329 production and 633 developer tests passed on unchanged sources, plus final combined 0.8.4 real pyMHF offline discovery and six temporary preferences. Actual Python and Windows PowerShell 5.1 check-only both accepted the selected installation/runtime without setup, staging, game launch or injection. No live 0.8.4 launch; prior 0.8.2/0.8.3 artifacts remain unchanged.
biome_preference: Optional and default ON, only in Random on PlanetOnFoot. Prefer eligible owned pets whose native habitat matches the normalized current planet habitat; fallback to the full eligible pool if unknown or no match. Ignored in stations/Nexus and last-manual mode. A chosen pet remains fixed during deferred retries.
deferred_summon: No default deadline; native eligibility and placement still required. Probe pairs paced at 0.5 seconds. Rejected requests retain the same choice until success or cancellation.
controls: CompanionAutoSummon tab in the separate pyMHF window; no mod hotkey
legacy_data_directory: NMS-AutoPet is intentionally retained for settings, remembered companions and the existing development runtime; schemas and file contents are unchanged.
startup_summon: One opportunity after successful local save load with automation enabled. No native summon calls during deserialization. Resolve a saved identity or Random through later local ownership updates and existing 1.5-second stability/placement checks; respect active/queued pets, preview, manual choice, ship entry, settings changes and context replacement. Never rearm merely because a pet is absent.
startup_summon_verification_scope: One Random-mode startup on a space station: save load armed at 20:42:58.578, location enum 2, request accepted at 20:43:01.261, user confirmed actual pet appearance. Nexus was explicitly not the test location.
manual_dismissal_verification_scope: Not live-verified for 0.4.5; no automatic retry or timing change is intended.

previous_production_verification.scope: 0.4.3 in combined play trial 0.6.2 registered with automation ON and two Mods/ten managed hooks on 27 September 2026. One on-foot station load in Random armed via save load (no ship-exit trigger before that startup request), chose slot 1 from five eligible owned companions, and queued it after 2.69 seconds. The player confirmed actual appearance. The player later confirmed one manual dismissal without reappearance after traveling in the unchanged session; exact dismissal location and duration were not independently measured. This does not verify Nexus/planet startup, Last manually selected startup, broader dismissal regression, biome preference, multiplayer or all settings.
previous_production_verification.manual_dismissal_scope: One player-reported manual dismissal without reappearance during combined 0.6.2 / production 0.4.3. The suggested check was about ten seconds on foot, but exact location, timestamp and duration were not independently measured. Travel separated this from the initial station load; no claim of a controlled immediately-after-startup dismissal test.

A solid white disc appears above the otherwise visible HUD status text; icon/render suppression has not been validated.

Complete live preference validation, remapping/controllers and held input await testing.
